title: Periodic inspection repair.
officialText:
All defects as found in such periodic inspection report shall be
corrected within 90 days after the date of test. An affirmation of correction shall be filed within 14 days of the
date of correction.
**Section 28-304.6.6 was added by Local Law 126 of 2021. This provision has an effective date of January 1, 2022.
